title: Mem2A commit
description: The agent's report of what it did, against the dossier version it relied on. Sent by the agent as a data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.commit+json`) in a follow-up message on the same task.

basedOn.description: The version of the dossier the agent relied on. Memory refuses the commit unless it equals the task's current dossier version.

action.description: The action taken. SHOULD equal the intent's `action`.

summary.description: What the agent did, in one plain sentence.

claims.description: What is now true because of the action. Each becomes a fact with status `claim`.

conflicts.description: Items in the current dossier that the action, already taken, goes against. Memory records them and routes them to a person.
